status: temporary production asset: hand-authored vector rigs traced from the supplied references, pending an illustrator-made rig

references.drone: IMG_2442.gif (UPLIFT quadcopter, 13 frames) and ScreenRecording_10-24-2026_17-35-25_1.mov (motion art direction)

parts.shadow: ground shadow (squashes on jumps and runs)
parts.rig: whole body: squash, stretch, lean, bob (pivot at the feet)
parts.leg-l: left leg and foot (pivot at the hip)
parts.foot-r: right foot, taps from the heel
parts.body: red droplet/flame silhouette with shading and gloss
parts.iris: pupil group moved only by the gaze loop (7 units of travel)
parts.mouth: mouth shapes: smile, grin, o, yawn, chew, wobble, snore
parts.arm-r: right arm (waves; pivot at the shoulder)
parts.apple: green apple prop: whole, bitten, core

parts.lift-lines: hover motion lines under the hull
parts.blades: spinning blades inside each rotor disc

runtime: No animation library: Web Animations API clips (src/pocket/actors/clips.js), one requestAnimationFrame loop each for the eye and the drone, CSS keyframes for rotors and the hover bob.
illustratorRequests: Mascot side/three-quarter run cycle (4-6 drawings) with separated legs and arms; the current run reuses the front view with a lean.
Mascot back-of-head and turn-around drawings for the skid and the duck under the curl.
Folded-arms pose drawn as overlapping forearms with hands tucked (current version is a simplified fold).
Mascot hands in three states (open palm for waving, fist, holding) as separate layers.
Apple-eating sequence: two-hand hold, cheek bulge drawings and a proper core toss.
Yawn stretch and a curled-up sleeping pose with its own Z artwork in the Vodafone palette.
Mouth shapes for the full set above drawn to the reference style (tongue, teeth, lip line).
Drone: rotor blur discs and blade drawings per guard, a banked (tilted) view and a top view for the heart path, so heading can turn rather than only tilt.
Hand-drawn heart trail as a vector brush (variable dash length and pressure) instead of the generated dash pattern.
Ideally a single Rive file with a state machine exposing gaze x/y, expression and the clips listed above.
